record.paper_title: Quadratic Stochastic Operators: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Analogue of F-QSO theorem for ξ-QSOs
record.original_question: Let xi = {E_1, ..., E_q} be a partition of the species set E, and define a xi-QSO by requiring P_{ij,k} = 0 whenever both parent indices i and j lie in the same block E_p. For F-QSOs, every trajectory converges exponentially to a unique fixed point. Does an analogous unique-fixed-point and global-convergence theorem hold for every xi-QSO?

evidence.quote: Theorem 5. [39] Any F -QSO has a unique fixed point (1, 0, ..., 0) (with m zeros). Besides, for any x0 ∈ S m , the trajectory {x(n) } tends to this fixed point exponentially rapidly.

Problem 10. Consider a partition ξ = {E1 , ..., Eq } of E i.e., E = E1 ∪...∪Eq , Ei ∩Ej = ∅, i 6= j. Assume Pij,k = 0 if i, j ∈ Ep , for p = 1, ..., q. Call the corresponding operator a ξ−QSO. Is an analogue of Theorem 5 true for any ξ−QSO?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E=\{1,2,\dots,m\}$ be a finite set ("species set") and let $S^{m-1}=\{x=(x_1,\dots,x_m)\in\mathbb{R}^m: x_i\geq 0,\ \sum_i x_i=1\}$ be the standard simplex. A quadratic stochastic operator (QSO) on $S^{m-1}$ is a map $V:S^{m-1}\to S^{m-1}$ defined by
$$ (Vx)_k = \sum_{i,j=1}^m P_{ij,k}\, x_i x_j,\qquad k=1,\dots,m, $$
where the coefficients satisfy $P_{ij,k}\geq 0$, $P_{ij,k}=P_{ji,k}$, and $\sum_{k=1}^m P_{ij,k}=1$ for all $i,j$.

Let $\xi=\{E_1,\dots,E_q\}$ be a partition of $E$, i.e. $E=E_1\cup\cdots\cup E_q$ with $E_p\cap E_r=\emptyset$ for $p\neq r$. A QSO is called a $\xi$-QSO if it satisfies the additional vanishing condition
$$ P_{ij,k}=0\qquad\text{whenever } i,j\in E_p\text{ for some } p\in\{1,\dots,q\}, $$
for every $k\in E$.

For any $x^{(0)}\in S^{m-1}$, define the trajectory $x^{(n+1)}=V(x^{(n)})$.

Question: Is it true that every $\xi$-QSO (for every choice of $m$ and every partition $\xi$ of $E$) has a unique fixed point in $S^{m-1}$ to which every trajectory $\{x^{(n)}\}_{n\geq 0}$ converges, and moreover does so exponentially fast?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches return only partial results for $\xi$-QSOs: classifications and dynamics on the two-dimensional simplex (small $m$) and special subclasses such as $\xi^{(s)}$- and $\xi^{(a)}$-QSOs, where various conjugacy and convergence results are obtained case by case. No source establishes a unique-fixed-point/global-exponential-convergence theorem for arbitrary $\xi$-QSOs, indicating the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: On ξ(s)-Quadratic Stochastic Operators on Two-Dimensional Simplex and Their Behavior
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies ξ(s)-QSOs on the 2D simplex into 20 nonconjugate classes and studies dynamics class by class.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial classification and dynamical analyses exist for restricted families of ξ-QSOs in low dimension.

status_evidence.title: Global and local behavior of a class of ξ(s)-QSO
status_evidence.snippet: Studies global/local behavior of a specific class of ξ(s)-QSO.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence results are obtained for special subclasses, not for general ξ-QSOs.

status_evidence.title: Genetic Algebras Associated with ξ(a)-Quadratic Stochastic Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates algebraic properties and dynamics of ξ(a)-QSOs on the two-dimensional simplex.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to address subclasses of ξ-QSOs, supporting that the general analogue remains unresolved.
